course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice summarizing what was heard with short att clauses.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague gives a quick recap of a conversation, plan, or update.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing key information without repeating every detail.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik recap a short conversation or update and decide what they need to remember.

main_focus.name: short summaries with att clauses
main_focus.description: Use att clauses to summarize the main point of information that was heard.
model_examples: Jag förstod att vi ska ses klockan tre.
Det viktigaste var att planen ändrades.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use short att-clause summaries naturally 2-3 times.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use recap chunks that help the learner structure a brief spoken summary.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks for a quick recap of an update or conversation.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize two key points using short att clauses.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the most important detail and what to do next.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat short att summaries rather than long explanations

focus: the detail that is most important to remember
the next action or decision after the recap

sentence_focus: one sentence with Jag förstod att
one sentence with Det viktigaste är att
one sentence about remembering a change
one sentence summarizing a plan in one clause
